test_title: PYST 36: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All colours are paints.

Some colours are pencils.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some paints are colours.

II. Some paints are pencils.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn Diagram is shown below;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15bc706810dd96f5573418d279fe1cd7cd3adde7588ed9ecfbac5171372bdaaf.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some paints are colours → **Follow** (As all colours are paints, then the case is definite)

II. Some paints are pencils → **Follow** (As Some colours are pencils, then some paints are pencils is definite)

So, Both the conclusions will follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option (2).**
